title: You need it.
body: Am I crazy or does this smell like banana split dippin dots? They are my favorite and I can’t get them out of my head when I use this lol. I got a small edition in a Sephora favorites and I adore this! I hate using thick balms straight on my lips so I usually do a chapstick type one and then a lip mask on top because then it glides on but with this I don’t have to do that! It just melts into my lips. Lots of product, affordable, pleasant smell, color and texture and actually works. Can’t go wrong.
bodyKo: 내가 미친 건가요, 이거 바나나 스플릿 딥핀 도츠 냄새 안 나나요? 그게 제가 제일 좋아하는 건데 이거 쓰면 계속 생각나요 ㅋㅋ 세포라 페이보릿에서 작은 사이즈로 받아서 완전 좋아해요! 두꺼운 밤을 입술에 바로 바르는 거 싫어해서 보통은 챕스틱 같은 거 바르고 그 위에 립 마스크 바르는데 이건 그럴 필요가 없어요! 그냥 입술에 녹아요. 양도 많고, 가격도 착하고, 향도 좋고, 색감과 제형도 좋고, 실제로 효과도 있어요. 실패할 일이 없어요.

title: A must have for Winter
body: This is amazing. I use it every night. My lips look so plump in the morning and the hydration lasts all day. My daughter is a mouth breather when she sleeps haha, so her lips were perpetually chapped but not since she started using this at night. As an added bonus, I swear my lips look fuller since I started using it.
bodyKo: 이거 진짜 대박이에요. 매일 밤마다 써요. 아침에 일어나면 입술이 완전 도톰해 보이고 수분감도 하루 종일 가더라고요. 제 딸은 자면서 입으로 숨 쉬는 편이라 입술이 항상 트곤 했는데 이거 쓰고 나서부터는 전혀 안 그래요. 보너스로, 이거 쓰기 시작한 이후로 입술이 더 도톰해 보이는 것 같아요.

body: Love the smell and taste. It has helped my lips heal, as I tend to have very dry lips in the winter. It makes a beautiful color on the lips. Barely there but glows.
bodyKo: 향도 맛도 너무 좋아요. 겨울에 입술이 너무 건조한 편인데 이거 덕분에 입술이 많이 회복됐어요. 입술에 발랐을 때 색도 예쁘게 은은하게 빛나요.

body: PERFECT i love mangos so the scent is perfect and i put this on at night and wake up in the morning with it still there and my lips feel so hydrated
bodyKo: 완벽해요. 망고 향 너무 좋아해서 딱이에요. 밤에 바르고 자면 아침까지 남아 있고 입술도 촉촉해요.

body: Best best product! This is the best Sephora purchase ever. I love the original flavor the most , super hydrating and it gives baby soft lips every single time!
bodyKo: 최고 중 최고 제품이에요! 세포라에서 산 것 중에 제일 좋아요. 오리지널 향이 제일 좋고, 수분감 최고에 매번 아기 피부처럼 부드러운 입술 만들어줘요!

title: This rescued my poor chapped lips!
body: This lip mask got me through my first north east winter with ease. I’m from a hot humid climate originally, so my lips were in a panic in all the negative degree temperatures, wind, and snow. The cold dry air was absolutely assaulting my lips - until I found this gem! Used in combo with a sugar scrub, this product repairs, hydrates, and protects your lips in an instant. This product feels so luscious and smooth, and makes your lips so plump and pouty and soft. This is an absolute fall and winter essential! I can’t imagine a winter without it now. It’s a true necessity.
bodyKo: 이 립 마스크 덕분에 첫 동북부 겨울을 무사히 넘겼어요. 원래 습하고 더운 지역 출신이라 영하의 온도, 바람, 눈에 입술이 완전 난리였거든요. 차갑고 건조한 공기가 입술을 완전히 공격했는데, 이 제품을 발견하고 나서야 해결됐어요! 슈가 스크럽과 함께 쓰면 즉각적으로 입술을 회복시키고, 촉촉하게 보호해줘요. 제형도 부드럽고 입술이 통통하고 도톰해져서 너무 좋아요. 가을, 겨울 필수템이에요! 이제 이거 없인 겨울을 상상할 수 없어요. 진짜 필수품이에요.

body: Leaves my lips soft and supple in the morning. Hydrated lips all winter long.
bodyKo: 아침에 입술이 부드럽고 촉촉해져요. 겨울 내내 입술이 촉촉하게 유지됐어요.

title: Omg
body: Omg.  This has your lips feeling super soft. It does remove dry skin(my daughter tried it and was amazed that her super dry lips were gone). Its glossy and smells good.
bodyKo: 와우. 입술이 엄청 부드러워져요. 각질도 제거해줘요(딸이 써보고 엄청 건조했던 입술이 사라졌다며 놀랐어요). 광택도 있고 향도 좋아요.

title: lies, lies, lies…
body: I really wanted to love this. I’ve heard such good things about it from others and for the week I used it I thought it would be the same. When I put it on it’s very soft but when I wake up in the morning my lips are drier than they were before. I didn’t realize the product was the thing doing it until I read other reviews saying the same thing. Very disappointed but glad I got it as part of my birthday gift and not purchasing the whole thing. I know it works for others so I say if you can get a sample, try it because you never know! Not for me but that’s ok.
bodyKo: 정말 좋아하고 싶었어요. 다른 사람들한테서 좋은 얘기 많이 들었고, 일주일 써보니 똑같을 줄 알았거든요. 바르면 부드럽긴 한데 아침에 일어나면 오히려 입술이 더 건조해져 있어요. 제품 때문인 줄 몰랐는데 다른 리뷰들도 똑같이 말해서 알게 됐어요. 많이 실망했지만 생일 선물로 받아서 다행이지 직접 사진 않았어요. 다른 사람들에겐 효과가 있으니 샘플이라도 써보는 걸 추천해요. 저한텐 안 맞지만 괜찮아요.

body: Great lip mask! I appreciate even more as it gets colder outside, it has healed the dryness and chaps my lips have developed. I don’t just use it at night I use it in the morning and during the day as well.
bodyKo: 정말 좋은 립 마스크예요! 날씨가 추워질수록 더 고마워요. 입술이 건조하고 트는 걸 완전히 치료해줬어요. 밤에만 쓰는 게 아니라 아침이나 낮에도 계속 사용해요.

title: Luxurious, baby soft skin.
body: Drunk Elephant is quickly becoming my favorite skincare brand! After trying their products I see why they come with a hefty price tag. It’s worth every penny. This is the best moisturizer I’ve ever used period. Whenever I use this moisturizer I look so baby faced, fresh, and glowing. It leaves my skin feeling truly baby soft, supple, and plump like no other product I’ve tried. It’s not too sticky, it’s not too watery, it’s not too heavy - it’s just perfect. It has almost a pillowy texture, and leaves your skin with that same pillowy plumpness. It feels like it’s genuinely hydrating my skin so deeply. I’m in love - this is my forever favorite moisturizer! Can’t recommend this product enough.
bodyKo: Drunk Elephant가 점점 제가 가장 좋아하는 스킨케어 브랜드가 되고 있어요! 제품을 써보니 왜 가격이 비싼지 알겠더라고요. 그만큼의 가치가 충분해요. 지금까지 써본 보습제 중 단연 최고예요. 이 제품을 바르면 정말 아기 피부처럼 맑고 생기 넘치고 빛나요. 피부가 진짜 아기 피부처럼 부드럽고 탄력 있고 탱탱해져요. 끈적이지도 않고, 너무 묽지도 않고, 무겁지도 않고 딱 완벽해요. 쿠션감 있는 제형이라 바르고 나면 피부도 탱탱해진 느낌이에요. 피부를 깊숙이 진짜 촉촉하게 해주는 느낌이에요. 완전 반했어요 - 평생 애용할 보습제예요! 이 제품 진짜 추천해요.

title: Not worth the money
body: Not worth the money! Definitely overhyped and this Doctor on YouTube mentioned it was good for the elasticity. Disappointed on this product especially charging customers so much for not so great of a product.
bodyKo: 돈이 아까워요! 확실히 과대평가된 제품이에요. 유튜브에서 어떤 의사가 탄력에 좋다고 했길래 샀는데 실망이에요. 이렇게 비싼 가격에 별로 좋은 제품도 아니고요.

body: I love skincare even more than makeup and I first scooped this cram up the day it debuted on the Sephora app. It has a great texture and it moisturizes my normal to dry skin very well. It didn’t cause any breakouts and left my skin with a hydrated look.
bodyKo: 저는 메이크업보다 스킨케어를 더 좋아하는데 이 크림은 세포라 앱에 출시된 날 바로 샀어요. 제형도 좋고 보통에서 건성 피부에 아주 잘 촉촉함을 줘요. 트러블도 없었고 피부가 촉촉해 보였어요.

title: A MIRACLE!!!
body: I was hesitant to write a review because I don’t want all of you causing this to go out of stock and leaving me without any. But I have to tell you how amazing this is! I bought it after a free sample completely cleared and healed my skin after just a couple days’ use. IT’S AMAZING. I’ve been using it for two months (that’s about how long a tub will last, using almost every morning AND evening) and I just ordered another. Two months has made the lines on my forehead almost disappear and I can hardly feel them anymore either, my embarrassing acne in my 30’s is almost gone, and this stuff heals a breakout quickly. The cream feels incredible, soaks in completely, is not greasy, works great under makeup (Urban Decay liquid foundation), and doesn’t have any strange scents. IT’S LITERALLY PERFECT. Im now replacing all of my skincare with Drunk Elephant!
bodyKo: 재고가 없어서 못 사게 될까 봐 리뷰 쓰는 걸 망설였는데 이 제품이 얼마나 대단한지 꼭 알려드려야겠어요! 무료 샘플 써보고 며칠 만에 피부가 완전히 깨끗해지고 치유돼서 바로 샀어요. 정말 대단해요. 거의 매일 아침 저녁으로 두 달 정도 썼는데(한 통이 그 정도 가요) 또 주문했어요. 두 달 만에 이마 주름이 거의 사라졌고 거의 느껴지지도 않아요. 30대에 생긴 신경 쓰이던 여드름도 거의 없어졌고 트러블도 빨리 낫게 해줘요. 크림 제형도 너무 좋고 완전히 흡수되고 기름지지 않아요. 메이크업(Urban Decay 리퀴드 파운데이션) 위에 발라도 잘 맞고 이상한 향도 없어요. 진짜 완벽해요. 이제 Drunk Elephant 제품으로 스킨케어 전부 바꾸려 해요!

title: LOVE THIS MOISTURIZER
body: Perfect consistency for so many different kinds of skin types! Clean product great packaging & formula. Will be repurchasing for sure. Hydrating soothing plumping and moisturizing without being too heavy.
bodyKo: 여러 피부 타입에 딱 맞는 완벽한 제형이에요! 클린한 제품이고 포장과 포뮬러도 훌륭해요. 꼭 재구매할 거예요. 촉촉하고 진정시키고 탱탱하게 해주면서도 무겁지 않아요.

body: The first time I used Protini ny skin felt instantly protected, moisturized, and comfortable. A great nighttime moisturizer for dry to normal skin, might be too heavy for combo/oily. My skin feels stronger, great for winter everyday. Can do every few nights in summer, switch with lighter cream.
bodyKo: 처음 Protini를 사용했을 때 피부가 즉시 보호받는 느낌이고 촉촉하며 편안했어요. 건성에서 중성 피부에 좋은 야간 보습제이고, 복합성이나 지성 피부에는 다소 무거울 수 있어요. 피부가 더 강해진 느낌이고 겨울철 매일 쓰기 좋아요. 여름에는 며칠 간격으로 사용하거나 가벼운 크림과 번갈아 써도 괜찮아요.

title: Worth the money
body: I’m 46 yo. Oily nose area, dry cheeks.  Use retinol S and acids. This lotion works perfectly to hydrate my skin, but not make me greasy looking. It’s my first drunk elephant purchase, and I’m very very happy with it. Will purchase again. Btw - my hands and finger nails love this lotion also.
bodyKo: 저는 46세이고 코는 지성, 볼은 건성 피부예요. 레티놀 S와 산 성분을 사용 중인데 이 로션이 피부에 수분을 잘 공급해 주면서도 번들거리지 않게 해줘서 딱 좋아요. Drunk Elephant 제품은 처음 구매했는데 정말 만족스러워요. 또 구매할 거예요. 참고로 손과 손톱도 이 로션을 좋아해요.

title: good, but cheaper alternatives out there
body: I’ve tried many other DE products and have always found them to be a home run for me, particularly their Vitamin C serum and their Glycolic night serum, as well as their Hydrating Serum. I have combo oily skin and had always heard good things about this cream so I finally went for it during a VIB sale. It’s good. I liked the consistency, not too tacky and sticky like alot of gel moisturizers, and I liked how it delivered just the right amount of hydration. It absorbed into my skin nicely and didn’t ever feel oily. However, this lasted just under 2 months, with me using it as a day cream. It seems like a lot of money for something where there are alot of good alternatives. Enjoyed this and might even repurchase it in the future at a heavy discount but will opt for cheaper alternatives.
titleKo: 괜찮긴 한데 더 저렴한 대안도 있어요
bodyKo: 다른 Drunk Elephant 제품들을 많이 써봤는데 특히 비타민 C 세럼, 글리콜릭 나이트 세럼, 하이드레이팅 세럼이 저한테는 항상 잘 맞았어요. 복합성 지성 피부이고 이 크림에 대해 좋은 평을 많이 들어서 VIB 세일 때 드디어 구매했어요. 괜찮아요. 제형도 마음에 들고, 많은 젤 타입 보습제처럼 끈적거리거나 끈적이지 않고 적당한 수분감을 줘요. 피부에 잘 흡수되고 기름지지 않아요. 다만, 낮에 크림으로 써봤는데 2개월 조금 못 가서 다 썼어요. 가격 대비 대안이 많아서 가성비는 아쉬워요. 사용감은 좋았고, 할인할 때 다시 살 수도 있지만 더 저렴한 제품을 선택할 것 같아요.

title: Nice product... but my mind isn't blown
body: I really do enjoy this product first of all! It has a nice texture, lovely ingredients, and leaves my skin feeling nice. I didn’t notice a dramatic difference in my skin while using this product however. I feel that my texture and fine lines are more or less the same. I’ve only been using it for about 4 months, so maybe that is a factor. However, I’m not sure I can justify the price. It more or less acts like a “nice“ moisturizer. It possible my skin just needs something more moisturizing in winter months. I wouldn’t write this product off completely, but for me it wasn’t the HG product I thought I might be based another reviews. Maybe I’ll give it another try in the future.
titleKo: 괜찮은 제품이긴 한데 크게 감탄하지는 않았어요
bodyKo: 일단 이 제품은 정말 좋아해요! 제형과 성분이 마음에 들고 바른 뒤 피부도 편안해요. 하지만 쓰면서 피부에 극적인 변화는 못 느꼈어요. 피부 결이나 잔주름이 거의 그대로예요. 4개월 정도 써봤는데 그게 영향일 수도 있겠죠. 이 가격에 다시 살지는 고민돼요. 그냥 ‘괜찮은’ 보습제 역할을 하는 것 같아요. 겨울철에는 좀 더 보습력이 강한 게 필요한지도 모르겠어요. 완전히 이 제품을 포기하지는 않겠지만, 다른 리뷰들처럼 인생템은 아니었어요. 나중에 다시 시도해볼 수도 있겠네요.

title: Holy Grail
body: This is my new holy grail product. Got it as a tester and after trying it immediately ordered online (it was sold out at all 3 Sephoras near my house!). It is super hydrating, makes my face feel baby soft, and everyone has been complimenting me on how nice my skin has been looking lately! I seriously could not stop touching my face the first night and admiring how much healthier my skin looked. I love this product so much. There are a few drawbacks. I have been getting a few more whiteheads then normal (but they are not noticeable) and it is just okay for oily skin. (I have super oily T-zone and though this does not make it oilier, it does not keep my skin from being oily either.) But compared to how much better this makes my skin look, these small drawbacks are not a bother for me.
bodyKo: 이 제품은 제 인생템이에요. 테스트용으로 받아서 써보고 바로 온라인 주문했어요(집 근처 세포라 3곳 모두 품절이었어요!). 정말 촉촉하고 얼굴이 아기 피부처럼 부드러워져서 주변에서 피부 좋아졌다는 칭찬을 많이 받았어요! 첫날 밤에는 얼굴을 계속 만지면서 얼마나 피부가 건강해졌는지 감탄했어요. 이 제품 너무 좋아요. 단점도 몇 가지 있어요. 평소보다 좁쌀이 조금 더 생겼는데 눈에 띄진 않아요. 지성 피부에는 그냥 그런 편이에요. T존이 아주 지성인데 이 제품이 기름지게 만들진 않지만 기름짐도 잡아주진 않아요. 그래도 피부가 훨씬 좋아 보여서 이런 작은 단점들은 신경 쓰이지 않아요.

title: My Holy Grail
body: This product is the holy grail of my beauty routine.  I suffer from allergies and, as a result, often wear waterproof mascara and use setting spray to keep my makeup in place throughout the day.  This is the only product I have ever used that takes off every trace of makeup in one wash.  Everything about my skin has improved since I began using this balm.  I have even noticed improved length in my eyelashes because I no longer have to scrub and tug at my eyelashes to remove my mascara.  This balm takes off all traces of makeup, to the point that when I follow up with toner there is no residue left on the cotton ball.  It has not only saved my face, but also my white towels!  In addition to leaving my skin incredibly clean, it also leaves me feeling moisturized, not with that “tight“ feeling a lot of cleansers create.  I cannot recommend this product enough.

title: I’d give this more than 5 stars if I could!!
body: Okay, first off, I received this full size product complimentary from Influenster and Peace Out skincare for an honest review. But that in no way influenced my decision for greatness that is this product! I’m very skeptical when it comes to skin care, even more so with acne products. So to be honest, after the first round of testing this product, I noticed a difference, but thought my feelings on it would be a little biased. So I tried it out again, this time on a holy mother of God zit! I left it on overnight, over the problem area, and when I woke up I felt the circle to see if I could still feel a lump underneath. Sure enough I could, so I was thinking maybe the first time was indeed a fluke. I took the dot off, and the lump was not a zit, but the dot itself that had whatever it pulled from the zit overnight. My zit was GONE! OVERNIGHT! No squeezing, no pain, just clear skin under the magic that are these acne dots!I will absolutely be purchasing these again, and recommending this product to all my fellow acne sufferers! The only thing I should note is, and I only discovered this after trying the first time, was that your skin cannot have anything else on it before applying these dots. No toner, no moisturizer, no cream of any kind or it won’t adhere properly. But that’s literally my only tip as these are seriously a no brained, set it and forget it type of treatment! Thank you soooo much Peace Out God’s!!Note: I attached a picture of the dot after use so that you can see visual proof of its greatness. Sorry, I know that’s TMI, because who wants to see anyone’s zit crap?! Sometimes you just have to see to believe!

On non cystic acne It is the little miracle that I pop on and tomorrow it is either gone or opened to the surface that it’s easy to clean out and never be seen again.  Even using one 2 days in a row on the same area I have never experienced any type of drying or reaction, and I do have sensitive skin! They also are a decent color for my fair/light skin that I have walked around my house with a couple on my face and my husband never even notice until I turned my head and the light hit my face just right.

title: So Far, So Good
body: I only just recently started incorporating serums  into my skincare routine and found them to help keep my skin moisturized, smoother and more balanced. I didn’t quite know what to expect with this serum but was immediately intrigued when I saw that they incorporated  Long Life Herb, a superfood from Japan, & Niacinamide, into the formula. I also liked that the serum was vegan, clean and cruelty-free.  Unlike my other serums, the  main difference  I noticed immediately was it said in order to see optimal results, you would have to use it twice daily for four weeks. The first time I used this serum was in the morning, during my normal skin care routine. I used it after cleansing like the instructions said. I liked the texture and smell of this serum. The milky white consistency was not too thick and not too watery. The serum blended into the skin easily. There was a very, very, LIGHT fragrance that disappeared immediately after I applied it which I liked  despite not  liking fragranced products on my face. The serum dried slightly  tacky which I also liked. After it was completely dry I did notice a slight glow to my skin which I  really liked as well .Because I have oily skin, I usually am not a fan of products that  leave a glow or sheen-like effect, however I liked the fact that this serum was completely dry and my skin looked glowy versus actually being glowy.  The second day  I used this serum  I decided instead to use it after cleansing and moisturizing my face and used it in place of primer due to the tackiness. Again, because of my skin texture and type, I prefer a primer  that has  more of a tacky  feel to the skin as I find that my foundation sticks better, however I didn’t notice much of a difference. In terms of using it at night it had the same effects as it did in my morning routine. I’m excited to see how this serum  holds up to its claims* and how it effects my skin within the next four weeks.
bodyKo: 최근에야 세럼을 스킨케어 루틴에 도입했는데, 피부가 촉촉하고 부드러우며 균형 잡히는 데 도움이 되더라고요. 이 세럼은 뭘 기대해야 할지 잘 몰랐는데, 일본 슈퍼푸드인 롱 라이프 허브와 나이아신아마이드가 들어있다는 걸 보고 바로 관심이 갔어요. 비건, 클린, 크루얼티 프리라는 점도 마음에 들었고요. 다른 세럼과 달리, 최적의 효과를 보려면 하루 두 번, 4주간 사용해야 한다고 적혀 있었는데, 그게 가장 큰 차이점이었어요. 처음 사용한 날 아침, 평소 스킨케어 루틴대로 세안 후에 써봤는데, 제형과 향이 좋았어요. 우유빛 흰색 제형이 너무 묽지도, 너무 진하지도 않고 피부에 잘 스며들었어요. 정말 은은한 향이 있었는데, 바르고 나면 바로 사라져서 향이 있는 제품을 좋아하지 않는 저도 만족했어요. 세럼이 약간 끈적였는데, 그 점도 좋았고요. 완전히 마른 후에는 피부에 은은한 광이 돌았는데, 그게 정말 마음에 들었어요. 지성 피부라 보통 광이나 윤기가 도는 제품을 별로 안 좋아하는데, 이 세럼은 완전히 마른 상태에서 피부가 빛나 보여서 좋았어요. 둘째 날에는 세안 후 보습제를 바르고, 프라이머 대신 이 세럼을 써봤는데 끈적임 덕분에 파운데이션이 더 잘 밀착되는 느낌이었어요. 하지만 큰 차이는 못 느꼈어요. 밤에 쓸 때도 아침과 같은 효과를 봤고요. 앞으로 4주간 꾸준히 쓰면서 효과가 어떻게 나타날지 기대돼요.

title: Awesome serum
body: I recieved a sample of bareminerals skinlongevity long life herb serum in exchange for my honest feedback. I have used it twice and my skin feels soft and refreshed. I will definitely be purchasing this! Thanks bareminerals for a awesome serum
bodyKo: 베어미네랄스 스킨롱제비티 롱 라이프 허브 세럼 샘플을 받아 솔직한 후기를 남겨요. 두 번 써봤는데 피부가 부드럽고 상쾌해졌어요. 꼭 구매할 예정이에요! 멋진 세럼 만들어줘서 고마워요, 베어미네랄스!

title: Nice product
body: I received a sample of bareMinerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum from PINCHme. It was a small sample, but it felt nice and absorbed well into my skin without being greasy. It had a nice fragrance as well. Wish the sample had been larger so I could have used more to see additional results.
bodyKo: PINCHme에서 베어미네랄스 스킨롱제비티 롱 라이프 허브 안티에이징 페이스 세럼 샘플을 받았어요. 작은 샘플이었지만 기분 좋았고, 피부에 잘 흡수되면서도 번들거리지 않았어요. 향도 좋았고요. 샘플이 좀 더 컸으면 더 많이 써보고 추가 효과도 확인할 수 있었을 텐데 아쉬워요.

title: Innovative serum
body: I have switched all my beauty products to clean beauty so I was excited for this serum! Long life herb sounds very intriguing.I used it every morning and night with my skincare routine, two pumps was enough to cover my face and neck. I’d say the bottle lasts about 5-6 weeks for me, I still have a quarter left.I love how refreshing and earthy citrusy it smells and how light and easily it glides over skin. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized and glowing. I have a combination skin so I imagine it would not be that moisturizing for dry skin because of how light it is and immediately sinks into skin.After 4 weeks of consistent use my skin is clear, soft and refreshed. This is a great product for summer time use I don’t think it enough moisture and firming for colder months. The best thing about the product is that is CLEAN, innovative ingredients and glowing skin! I highly recommend if your skin is in need of boost of energy!
bodyKo: 모든 뷰티 제품을 클린 뷰티로 바꿔서 이 세럼이 정말 기대됐어요! 롱 라이프 허브라는 이름부터가 아주 흥미롭더라고요. 아침, 저녁 스킨케어 루틴에 매일 써봤는데, 두 번 펌핑으로 얼굴과 목까지 충분했어요. 제 기준으로 한 병에 5~6주 정도 쓸 수 있고, 아직 4분의 1 정도 남았어요. 상쾌하고 흙내음과 시트러스 향이 섞인 향이 너무 좋고, 가볍고 피부에 부드럽게 발려요. 피부에 바로 흡수되어 촉촉하고 빛나는 느낌을 줘요. 저는 복합성 피부라서, 너무 가벼워서 건성 피부에는 보습력이 부족할 수도 있겠다는 생각이 들었어요. 4주간 꾸준히 사용한 결과 피부가 맑고 부드러우며 상쾌해졌어요. 여름철 쓰기 좋은 제품이고, 추운 계절에는 보습과 탄력에 충분하지 않을 것 같아요. 이 제품의 가장 좋은 점은 클린한 성분과 혁신적인 포뮬러, 그리고 빛나는 피부 효과예요! 피부에 활력이 필요하다면 정말 추천해요!

body: I received a free sample and I love it! The product is very light on my skin and has helped with my uneven skin tone!
bodyKo: 무료 샘플을 받았는데 정말 마음에 들어요! 제품이 피부에 아주 가볍고, 피부 톤이 고르지 않은 데 도움이 되었어요!

body: I really enjoy this serum!! It smells really good, like fresh herbs. I got this about a month and a half ago and I am about a little under 3/4’s done with the bottle. I use this morning and night and I have noticed the redness in my cheeks have gotten a bit lighter!! This does not leave me oily or dry I really like this product
bodyKo: 이 세럼 정말 좋아요!! 향도 신선한 허브 같아서 너무 좋고요. 한 달 반 정도 써봤는데 거의 3/4 정도 썼어요. 아침저녁으로 쓰는데 볼에 있던 붉은 기가 좀 옅어진 것 같아요!! 유분기나 건조함 없이 딱 좋아서 이 제품 정말 마음에 들어요.

body: I received a free sample of Bare Minerals Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum from Pinchme.  I love the feel & how non greasy the serum is.  It made my skin feel so soft, wonderful & fabulous.
bodyKo: Pinchme에서 베어 미네랄스 스킨롱제비티 롱 라이프 허브 안티에이징 페이스 세럼 무료 샘플 받았어요. 세럼이 전혀 끈적이지 않고 사용감이 너무 좋아요. 피부가 정말 부드럽고 환해진 느낌이에요, 최고예요.

title: new fav
body: bare minerals is my new fav. of course I’ll have to use third for a while to see results.  but ive been really happy with other bare minerals products, makeup, lipstick
bodyKo: 베어 미네랄스가 제 새로운 최애예요. 물론 효과를 보려면 좀 더 써봐야겠지만요. 다른 베어 미네랄스 제품들, 메이크업이나 립스틱도 정말 만족하고 있어요.

body: I’ve been using this product for about 4 months now in the morning and it really gives me a glowy look. I have acne scars and I feel like it has helped but it took a while to even see a little bit of improvement. I also can’t even tell if this product is what’s helping my scars because they’ve been really small for a while now. I also did get a very small purge when I first started using it so I recommended starting with once every other day instead of everyday.
bodyKo: 이 제품을 아침마다 4개월 정도 사용 중인데 피부가 정말 빛나 보여요. 여드름 흉터가 있는데 조금 나아진 것 같긴 한데 효과가 나타나기까지 시간이 좀 걸렸어요. 흉터가 원래 작아서 이 제품 덕분인지 확실히 모르겠어요. 처음 쓸 때 약간 피부가 뒤집히기도 해서 매일 쓰기보단 이틀에 한 번씩 시작하는 걸 추천해요.

title: Free sample
body: I received this as a free sample. maybe it was the one that I recieved, but the smell was horrible. I’ll go back to using the one from The Ordinary, didn’t notice anything remarkably different between the two products.
bodyKo: 무료 샘플로 받았는데, 제가 받은 제품이 그런 건지 냄새가 너무 별로였어요. 다시 The Ordinary 제품으로 돌아갈 것 같아요. 두 제품 사이에 특별히 다른 점은 못 느꼈어요.

title: So Worth It!!!
body: I got this as a deluxe sample and my really wanted to not like this product. It’s considered a HG but that price is eye watering. It’s worth every penny though. I had several pimples flare up the day I decided to start my sample. By morning most of them were barely visible. I wanted to cry because it worked so well for my skin but that price tag does not agree with my wallet. I love it and wish I could purchase it more often.
bodyKo: 이거 디럭스 샘플로 받아서 솔직히 별로일 줄 알았는데, 이 제품이 명품이라고 불리는 이유를 알겠더라고요. 가격이 정말 눈이 휘둥그레질 정도지만, 그만큼의 가치가 있어요. 샘플 사용 시작한 날 여드름이 몇 개 올라왔는데, 아침이 되니까 거의 안 보일 정도로 가라앉았어요. 너무 좋아서 울 뻔했는데, 가격이 제 지갑 사정과는 맞지 않네요. 정말 좋아서 자주 사고 싶어요.

body: I’ve gotten enough samples of this to know it doesn’t work for me. My hyperpigmentation never did clear up. Plus it doesn’t smell good. I’m glad I didn’t plunk down a lot of money on it.
bodyKo: 이거 샘플을 여러 번 써봤는데 제 피부에는 효과가 없더라고요. 색소침착도 전혀 개선되지 않았고, 냄새도 별로예요. 돈 많이 안 쓰길 잘했다 싶어요.

title: Seriously the best!!!!!
body: This stuff is incredible! Seriously I do not care how much it costs, it is the best skincare product I have ever used. Yes it smells like weird lemongrass (aka gross gross gross).. but it exfoliates and brightens unlike anything else. I rarely see a remarkable difference using skincare products, but this one is consistently amazing.Try it.. give it more than a few days to work. If you aren’t used to properly exfoliating your skin, you may see a few pimples and thats normal. But this wont irritate your skin like other exfoliants.YOU WILL NOT BE DISAPPOINTED :)
bodyKo: 이 제품 정말 대단해요! 가격이 얼마든 상관없어요, 제가 써본 스킨케어 중 최고예요. 네, 레몬그라스 냄새가 좀 이상해요(완전 별로).. 하지만 각질 제거랑 피부 톤 밝히는 효과는 다른 제품과 비교할 수 없어요. 스킨케어 제품 써서 이렇게 확실한 변화를 본 적이 드문데, 이건 꾸준히 놀라워요. 꼭 써보세요.. 며칠만 써보고 판단하지 말고요. 각질 제거에 익숙하지 않으면 여드름이 좀 올라올 수 있는데 그건 정상이에요. 그리고 다른 각질 제거제처럼 피부 자극도 없어요. 절대 실망하지 않을 거예요 :)

body: I have never tried anything from Sunday Riley before and I wish I had! This was complimentary from Sunday Riley. The good genes serum was easy to use and also effective. I started using it once every other day because I have sensitive my skin. It has significantly cleared up my mascne.
bodyKo: 선데이 릴리 제품은 처음 써봤는데 왜 이제야 써봤나 싶어요! 선데이 릴리에서 무료로 받은 제품이에요. 굿 진스 세럼은 쓰기도 쉽고 효과도 좋았어요. 저는 민감한 피부라 이틀에 한 번씩 써봤는데, 여드름이 많이 좋아졌어요.

title: She is Powerful, learn how to use her !
body: If you go slow your skin will glow!!! I get addicted to the soft magical overnight transformation from good genes and as a consequence, I have suffered the purging but it’s worth it!!! I’m on my second bottle and my skin is now adjusted to this. I recommend starting out to use it once a week for a few weeks and then twice, etc. it’s seriously powerful. I also recommend using it for KP on the back of your arms and for any little chest/back acne.
bodyKo: 천천히 쓰면 피부가 빛나요!!! 굿 진스의 부드럽고 마법 같은 밤사이 변화에 중독됐고, 그 결과로 피부 정화 현상을 겪었지만 그만한 가치가 있어요!!! 지금 두 번째 병을 쓰고 있는데 피부가 이제 적응했어요. 처음에는 일주일에 한 번씩 몇 주간 사용하다가 두 번으로 늘려가길 추천해요. 정말 강력해요. 팔 뒤쪽의 각질 개선과 가슴/등에 난 작은 여드름에도 사용하길 추천해요.

body: Give this a chance! I bought the big bottle, and after a couple weeks, I saw nothing and almost gave up. I kept using a pea sized amount every night. Omg. I ran out and now I feel like an addict and NEED it! This got rid of all of my melasma post-pregnancy. I had it on the outer corners of my eyes, forehead, and upper lip. Gone. It’s GONE! Because I’m on a budget right now, I’m going through withdrawals - you will not regret this purchase! I have combo skin that is SUPER sensitive. My cheeks, nose, chin, and forehead are a tundra in winter and your greasiest pizza every other season. This works for all of them.
bodyKo: 한번 써보세요! 큰 용량으로 샀는데 몇 주 동안은 변화가 없어서 거의 포기할 뻔했어요. 매일 밤 완두콩 크기만큼 꾸준히 썼죠. 와우. 다 쓰고 나니까 중독된 기분이고 꼭 필요해요! 이거 덕분에 임신 후 생긴 기미가 완전히 사라졌어요. 눈가 바깥쪽, 이마, 윗입술에 있었는데 다 없어졌어요. 진짜 사라졌어요! 지금은 예산이 빠듯해서 금단 현상 중인데, 이 제품 구매 절대 후회 안 하실 거예요! 저는 복합성 피부에 엄청 민감한 편인데, 겨울에는 볼, 코, 턱, 이마가 꽁꽁 얼어붙은 듯하고 다른 계절에는 기름기가 많아요. 이 제품은 그런 모든 피부 상태에 잘 맞아요.

title: AMAZING
body: Received this and “Luna“ as a gift and I have seen a huge difference in just TWO days. I can’t even believe it. Miracle product. Thank you Sunday Riley!
bodyKo: 이거랑 ‘루나’를 선물로 받았는데 단 이틀 만에 큰 변화를 봤어요. 믿기지 않아요. 기적 같은 제품이에요. Sunday Riley 감사해요!

title: Wonderful
body: I love this product I received Gifted by Sunday Riley.I have noticed I have had a change in my skin clarity and fullness. My skin feels more radiant. I put this on fresh clean and washed skin. It’s lovely. Makes my skin more noticeably brighter and my pores seem smaller. My wrinkles on my forehead don’t seem as pronounced anymore.  I really enjoy this product.
bodyKo: Sunday Riley에서 선물로 받은 제품인데 너무 좋아요. 피부 투명도와 탄력이 좋아진 걸 느꼈어요. 피부가 더 빛나고 모공도 작아진 것 같아요. 이마 주름도 덜 도드라져 보여요. 정말 만족하며 쓰고 있어요.

title: Only ok
body: I think it’s working... some days I notice a difference in my skin some days I don’t.. I don’t really know if it’s truly worth it. I use it at night before my moisturizer and I haven’t noticed a significant difference in my skin but I’ll keep trying.
bodyKo: 효과가 있는 것 같긴 한데... 어떤 날은 피부가 달라진 걸 느끼고 어떤 날은 모르겠어요. 진짜 가치가 있는지 잘 모르겠네요. 밤에 보습제 바르기 전에 쓰는데 피부에 큰 변화는 못 느꼈지만 계속 써볼게요.

title: I love
body: I was using the Mermaid Skin™ Hyaluronic H2O Serum and loved it but not the price, so I wanted to replace it with something similar but a little more in my price range and I loved this so much!!!! I feel like this helped with hydration and didn’t break me out at all!! So love love loveee the product and the price!!
bodyKo: Mermaid Skin™ 히알루론산 H2O 세럼을 쓰다가 가격이 부담돼서 비슷하면서 가격대가 좀 더 맞는 걸 찾았는데 이 제품이 너무 좋았어요! 수분 공급에 도움 되고 트러블도 전혀 없었어요! 제품도 가격도 너무 만족해요!

title: I like it :)
body: I’ve been enjoying this product. It goes on smooth, dries nice to the touch and I can layer on top, no problem there.
bodyKo: 이 제품 정말 잘 쓰고 있어요. 발림성도 부드럽고, 마르면 사용감도 좋아서 그 위에 다른 제품 덧발라도 전혀 문제없어요.

title: my new go to
body: After my Skinceuticals ran out I thought I would give it a try and I will def not be going back. Hydrated and plumped my skin. Absolutely love! I am acne prone skin and didn’t break me out.
bodyKo: 스킨수티컬즈 다 쓰고 나서 한번 써봤는데 절대 다시 안 돌아갈 거예요. 피부가 촉촉해지고 탱탱해졌어요. 완전 좋아요! 저는 여드름 피부인데도 트러블 없었어요.

title: The best acne solution everrrrr
body: First of all, this product is so cheap compared to other skincare products and is definitely worth the buy. I have really bad acne especially on my forehead and with less than 1 week of usage, my skin is already so much cleaner. I use it in the morning and at night before using my moisturizer. The first few seconds of using the product, the product is really liquidy. After you dab the product into your skin, a few seconds later the product will fully “dissolve“ and leave a sticky, but refreshing residue. (the stickiness is not bad at all btw). This product has helped my skin feel and look so much healthier and I absolutely recommend it to anyone with bad acne and blemishes. This is my full honest opinion, 10 out of 10 in love.
bodyKo: 일단 이 제품은 다른 스킨케어 제품들에 비해 가격이 정말 저렴하고, 확실히 살 가치가 있어요. 특히 이마에 심한 여드름이 있는데 1주일도 안 돼서 피부가 훨씬 깨끗해졌어요. 아침, 저녁으로 보습제 바르기 전에 사용해요. 처음 바를 때는 제형이 정말 묽어요. 피부에 톡톡 두드리면 몇 초 후에 완전히 흡수되면서 끈적이지만 상쾌한 잔여감이 남아요. (끈적임이 전혀 불쾌하지 않아요.) 이 제품 덕분에 피부가 훨씬 건강해 보이고 느껴져서 여드름과 잡티 있는 분들께 강력 추천해요. 진심으로 10점 만점에 10점, 완전 반했어요.

title: Not working for me
body: Why it works for others but not me? It peels every time when I use it, every time? It dries up in my face leaving a white residual, if I apply in a patchy area, you can actually tell where I apply the product. Sad :(
bodyKo: 왜 다른 사람들한텐 잘 맞는데 저한텐 안 맞는 걸까요? 쓸 때마다 각질이 일어나요, 매번요? 얼굴에 하얀 잔여물이 남고, 부분적으로 바르면 바른 부위가 확실히 보여서 속상해요 :(

body: I’ve been using this as a part of a two-step lip care regimen. Add a tiny bit on your lips, wait until it dries a bit 30-60 seconds, then add some Vaseline over top. It’s honestly the best lip care I’ve ever done. It lasts pretty well all day, although I also use a lip balm with spf like once or twice a day, for what it’s worth. This two step system works better than anything I’ve tried- and I’ve tried a plethora of lip balms.
bodyKo: 이 제품을 2단계 립 케어 루틴으로 사용 중이에요. 입술에 소량 바르고 30~60초 정도 살짝 마를 때까지 기다린 후 바셀린을 덧발라요. 솔직히 지금까지 해본 립 케어 중에 최고예요. 하루 종일 꽤 오래 가고, 저는 SPF 들어간 립밤도 하루에 한두 번 정도 같이 써요. 이 2단계 시스템이 제가 써본 어떤 립밤보다 효과가 좋아요.

body: It is a good product all around in it delivers exactly what it says it will. It just goes on so thick and I always get a lot of build up from it. Will not buy again due to those issues. It could be user error.
bodyKo: 전반적으로 좋은 제품이고, 말한 대로 효과를 잘 보여줘요. 다만 너무 묵직하게 발리고, 항상 겹쳐 바르면 뭉침이 생겨서 그 점 때문에 재구매는 안 할 것 같아요. 사용자 문제일 수도 있겠지만요.

title: Great Formula
body: Very nice formula, feel great on the skin. Hydrating without feeling heavy at all
bodyKo: 정말 좋은 포뮬러고 피부에 닿는 느낌도 좋아요. 무겁지 않으면서도 촉촉해요.

title: make sure to use moisturizer with this!
body: I have bought several bottles of this in the past year! It is so well priced and so effective! I used it at night with my other creams, immediately after drying my face I put a liberal amount of this on and then follow up with one of my moisturizers, I do recommend using another cream or oil moisturizer with this because it kind of dries quickly and your face becomes taught, it retains moisture but doesn’t necessarily ADD moisture, it’s like a supercharge for your actually moisturizer! I don’t plan on taking this out of my regimen any time soon, if ever! It’s my holy grail secret ingredient to my baby skin!
titleKo: 이거 쓸 땐 꼭 보습제랑 같이 쓰세요!
bodyKo: 지난 1년 동안 여러 병 샀어요! 가격도 착하고 효과도 정말 좋아요! 밤에 다른 크림 바르고 바로 얼굴 말린 다음 이걸 넉넉히 바르고 보습제 하나 더 발라요. 이 제품은 금방 마르면서 피부가 당기는데, 수분을 유지해주긴 하지만 수분을 직접 더해주진 않아요. 보습제 효과를 확실히 올려주는 느낌이에요! 당분간 절대 빼지 않을 거예요, 제 아기 피부 비결이니까요!

title: Love it
body: My husband and I use this cream.!! We loved it.!!!! It leaves our skin smooth and moisturized all day.!
bodyKo: 남편이랑 같이 쓰고 있어요. 정말 좋아요! 하루 종일 피부가 부드럽고 촉촉해져요!

body: Absolutely love this product! Absorbs into my skin nicely with no residue or greasy feeling. Moisturizes my dry skin, no more flaky skin. Not irritating to my dry sometimes sensitive skin. I have purchased this product multiple times. A bit pricy but I find the 100ml at 81$ a better bang for your buck than the smaller sizes so go big or go home.
bodyKo: 이 제품 정말 좋아해요! 피부에 잘 흡수되고 잔여감이나 번들거림 전혀 없어요. 건조한 피부에 촉촉함을 주고 각질도 없어졌어요. 가끔 민감한 피부에도 자극 없어요. 여러 번 구매했어요. 가격이 좀 있지만 100ml에 81달러가 작은 사이즈보다 가성비가 좋아서 큰 사이즈 추천해요.

title: Ok if you don’t need a lot of moisturizing
body: Not greasy, works short term. Not a heavy moisturizer so it didn’t work for my needs. For someone who doesn’t need much it’s great.
bodyKo: 끈적이지 않고 단기간에 효과가 있어요. 무거운 보습제는 아니라 제 피부에는 맞지 않았어요. 보습이 많이 필요 없는 분들께는 좋아요.

body: I love this moisturizer.  It’s so hydrating and my go to apply just before bed! I love that the formula isn’t sticky and I also really love the scent. I’m giving it 4 stars because I wish that it had SPF to use as a day moisturizer as well!  If you are looking for something to hydrate your skin definitely give this one a try!
bodyKo: 이 보습제 정말 좋아요. 너무 촉촉하고 자기 전에 꼭 바르는 제품이에요! 끈적이지 않는 제형도 마음에 들고 향도 정말 좋아요. 별 4개 준 이유는 SPF가 있었으면 낮에도 쓸 수 있었을 텐데 하는 아쉬움 때문이에요! 피부에 수분을 주는 제품 찾으신다면 꼭 한번 써보세요!

body: I like how hydrating the formula is. I think it just keeps he exact amount of richness that allows for me to wear it during the day instead of just at bedtime. To be fair I have dry skin.
bodyKo: 제형이 촉촉한 게 마음에 들어요. 낮에도 바를 수 있을 만큼 적당한 리치함을 유지해줘서 좋아요. 참고로 저는 건성 피부예요.

title: BEST MOISTURIZER EVER
body: This moisturizer is GREAT! It is lightweight - literally like water. Faint smell which I love! Probably my new favourite moisturizer!
bodyKo: 이 보습제 정말 좋아요! 가벼워서 거의 물 같아요. 은은한 향도 너무 좋아요! 아마 제 새 최애 보습제가 될 것 같아요!

body: Didn’t live this. Try Estée Lauder moisturizers for a great moisturizer. Also, broke me out :-(
bodyKo: 별로였어요. 좋은 보습제 찾으시면 에스티로더 제품 써보세요. 그리고 저한테는 트러블도 났어요 :-(

body: This was my first time using this moisturizer and I so far really like it. It is a bit thick but I don’t think it makes my face feel greasy. I don’t wear makeup so I don’t mind thicker products. Smells great and feels good after my retinol serum!
bodyKo: 이 보습제를 처음 사용해봤는데 지금까지는 정말 마음에 들어요. 약간 묵직한 편이지만 얼굴이 번들거리는 느낌은 없어요. 저는 메이크업을 하지 않아서 좀 더 묵직한 제품도 괜찮더라고요. 향도 좋고 레티놀 세럼 바른 후에 사용하니 기분이 좋아요!

body: This light weight moisturizer is absolutely amazing, I’ve always had the struggle of finding a good moisturizer for my skin! This product left my skin feeling fresh and so soft! Was revived complementary by Influenster!
bodyKo: 이 가벼운 보습제는 정말 대단해요, 피부에 맞는 좋은 보습제 찾느라 항상 고생했는데! 이 제품 덕분에 피부가 상쾌하고 부드러워졌어요! Influenster에서 무료로 받았어요!

title: Great product
body: I loved this moisturizer! It’s not too heavy for day use but not too light for night use. It’s perfect to travel with as it can be used as a day and night cream. I have oily skin and find most moisturizers feel greasy but this was perfect ☺️ Highly recommend you try it!
bodyKo: 이 보습제 정말 마음에 들었어요! 낮에 쓰기에도 무겁지 않고 밤에 쓰기에도 너무 가볍지 않아요. 낮과 밤 모두 쓸 수 있어서 여행 갈 때 딱이에요. 지성 피부인데 대부분 보습제가 번들거리는 느낌이었는데 이건 딱 좋아요 ☺️ 꼭 한번 써보시길 추천해요!

body: Love these guys, great for summer. Clear for the most part, little tint on a few. Hydrating and glossy but not super sticky. Smell amazing and packaging is pretty as well. Only reason it’s not a 5 is because it’s not life changing. Good product and I enjoy it.
bodyKo: 이 제품들 너무 좋아요, 여름에 딱이에요. 대부분 투명하고 몇몇은 약간 색이 있어요. 촉촉하고 윤기 나는데 끈적이지 않아요. 향도 정말 좋고 패키지도 예뻐요. 5점 만점에 4점인 이유는 인생템은 아니기 때문이에요. 좋은 제품이고 잘 쓰고 있어요.

title: pricy..but love it
body: I was not sure about getting this initially.  i love the sleeping mask so i thought. why not... andd i am glad i did. this lip balm works just as well as the sleeping mask . plus i like this better because i do not have to use my hand to use the product. this is more hygienic... love love love. easy to use and best for on the go. wish it was a bit cheaper .
bodyKo: 처음에는 살까 말까 고민했어요. 슬리핑 마스크가 좋아서 이거 왜 안 써보지 했는데, 써보길 잘했어요. 이 립밤도 슬리핑 마스크만큼 효과 좋아요. 게다가 손을 안 써도 돼서 더 위생적이에요... 정말 좋아요. 사용도 간편하고 외출할 때 최고예요. 가격이 좀 더 저렴했으면 좋겠어요.

body: I’ve been using this for a few days now (berry flavor) and I’m really enjoying the product/results! It’s not too sticky, phew! And it’s the perfect amount of color when your on the go (I use on lipstick free lips.) my lips feel super soft and hydrated although i do feel like i have to reapply a few times thoughout the day but that’s okay because it tates/smells delicious! I do wish this product had SPF in it, then it would be 5 stars for me. I received this complimentary but would buy it again!
bodyKo: 며칠째 이 제품(베리 향)을 사용 중인데 정말 만족하고 있어요! 끈적임도 적고, 휴~ 딱 외출할 때 바르기 좋은 적당한 컬러감이에요(립스틱 안 바른 입술에 사용해요). 입술이 정말 부드럽고 촉촉해지는데, 하루 중 몇 번 다시 발라야 하는 점은 있지만, 맛과 향이 너무 좋아서 괜찮아요! 이 제품에 SPF가 있었다면 별 다섯 개였을 텐데 아쉽네요. 무료로 받았지만 다시 구매할 의사 있어요!

title: lightweight, comfortable
body: I use the Laneige lip sleeping mask at night so I was excited to try out this lip balm for daytime. I picked up the berry one
bodyKo: 밤에는 Laneige 립 슬리핑 마스크를 사용해서 낮에 바를 립밤을 써보고 싶었어요. 베리 컬러로 골랐어요.

title: Hydrating But Not Too Pigmented
body: I love this lip balm so much! It is hydrating, smells SO lovely, and the packaging is beautiful. What prevents me from giving it 5 stars is that it is not very pigmented. I don’t mind because I use it in conjunction with other balms or under lipstick, but it could be improved with a bit more color.
bodyKo: 이 립밤 정말 좋아해요! 촉촉하고 향도 너무 좋고, 패키지도 예뻐요. 별 다섯 개를 주지 않은 이유는 색감이 진하지 않아서예요. 저는 다른 립밤이나 립스틱 아래에 함께 사용해서 괜찮지만, 좀 더 컬러가 진했으면 좋겠어요.

body: Not sure what people are talking about when they say this isn’t long lasting. I put it on late and then when I woke up, it was still there! Love the product. Wish the tube was bigger or that the price was lower
bodyKo: 지속력이 별로라는 평이 이해가 안 돼요. 늦게 바르고 잤는데 아침에도 남아 있었어요! 제품 정말 좋아요. 튜브가 좀 더 크거나 가격이 좀 더 저렴했으면 좋겠네요.

title: Perfect moisturizing balm
body: I really love this lip balm! The smell of grapefruit is very subtle but nice and it doesn’t taste bad! There is no real tint to it but it’s ok I really wanted a good moisturizing balm and this one is one of the best i’ve tried and I have to say I tried so much balms to find the right one ! It’s not sticky, it glides well, stays on for long and is really moisturizing like the sleeping mask without having to put the fingers in the jar! I’ll be ordering more of them it feels so nice on my dry lips.
bodyKo: 이 립밤 정말 좋아해요! 자몽 향이 은은하고 좋으며 맛도 나쁘지 않아요! 색감은 거의 없지만 괜찮아요. 좋은 보습 립밤을 찾고 있었는데, 이 제품이 제가 써본 것 중 최고예요. 끈적이지 않고 부드럽게 발리며 오래가고, 슬리핑 마스크처럼 손가락으로 덜지 않아도 돼서 편해요! 건조한 입술에 정말 기분 좋게 느껴져서 더 주문할 거예요.

title: Best Lip Gloss
body: I’m really not usually a lip gloss girl, but I got this complimentary from Influenster and I absolutely LOVE IT. My lips feel so moisturized and don’t dry out after extended use. It’s the perfect compliment to a fresh faced makeup look. The Berry color is beautiful. Not sticky and also wears well under lipstick. This is the perfect spring lip wear.
bodyKo: 원래 립글로스는 잘 안 쓰는데, 인플루언서에서 무료로 받아서 써봤는데 완전 마음에 들어요. 입술이 정말 촉촉하고 오래 써도 건조하지 않아요. 맑은 메이크업에 딱 어울리는 제품이에요. 베리 컬러도 예쁘고 끈적이지 않으면서 립스틱 아래에 발라도 잘 유지돼요. 봄에 딱 맞는 립 제품이에요.

body: I really liked how it felt on my lip at first, as it dries on your lips it has my lips really chapped. Disappointed, it does give a shiny gloss for a second.
bodyKo: 처음에는 입술에 발랐을 때 느낌이 좋았는데, 시간이 지나면서 입술이 많이 트더라고요. 좀 실망했어요. 잠깐 반짝이는 광택은 있어요.

title: Gentle but ineffective
body: I bought it due to the reviews and because my shiseido ibuki facewash was too stripping. It is indeed gentle but slips around and doesn’t take off eye makeup. Even with double cleansing, it failed to remove the oil from my oil cleanser. So it’s completely useless for me... would be as effective washing with warm water alone.

Great cleanser! My face feels clean and soft after using it. However, don’t feel like it helps too much with cleaning out my pores since it’s so light. I still have to use my other pore facial cleansers alternating with this one. Or else I’d get lots of blackheads really quickly.
bodyKo: 클렌저 좋아요! 사용 후 얼굴이 깨끗하고 부드러워요. 다만 너무 가벼워서 모공 속까지 깨끗하게 해주는 느낌은 없어요. 그래서 다른 모공 전용 클렌저랑 번갈아가며 써야 해요. 안 그러면 금방 블랙헤드가 많이 생겨요.

body: Love this cleanser, use it every day. Very gentle on dry skin. Doesn’t take off my makeup super well so I use it as the second part of a double cleanse if I wear makeup.
bodyKo: 이 클렌저 너무 좋아서 매일 써요. 건성 피부에도 아주 순해요. 메이크업은 완벽하게 지워지진 않아서, 메이크업할 때는 이중 세안 두 번째 단계로 사용해요.

title: Silky Fresh Cleanser
body: What a great cleanser! It’s gentle but it gets the job done. I’ve used it both alone and after an oil cleanser and it worked well to remove oil, dirt, and lots of makeup. Doesn’t leave skin feeling tight or dry. No irritating fragrance! It doesn’t foam or bubble much but it does have a slippery texture on wet skin. Skin feels refreshed and cleansed after. Highly recommend! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
bodyKo: 정말 좋은 클렌저예요! 순하면서도 세정력이 뛰어나요. 단독으로 써도 좋고 오일 클렌저 후에 써도 기름기, 먼지, 메이크업을 잘 지워줘요. 피부가 당기거나 건조해지지 않고 자극적인 향도 없어요! 거품이나 버블은 많이 나지 않지만, 젖은 피부에 미끄러운 제형이 있어요. 사용 후 피부가 상쾌하고 깨끗해진 느낌이에요. 정말 추천해요! 이 제품은 리뷰용으로 무료 제공받아 써봤어요.

body: This is a nice gentle cleanser that’s good for sensitive skin
bodyKo: 민감한 피부에 좋은 순한 클렌저예요.

body: I wish I could return this because it’s the worst for my skin. Didn’t take off makeup properly and my face broke out…. So many pimples! Not recommend
bodyKo: 반품하고 싶어요, 제 피부에는 최악이었거든요. 메이크업이 제대로 지워지지 않았고 얼굴에 트러블이 많이 났어요…. 여드름이 너무 많이 생겼어요! 추천하지 않아요.

title: Amazing
body: LOVE this product!! It has been my holy grail I will never buy another cleanser again!
bodyKo: 이 제품 너무 좋아요!! 제 인생템이라 다른 클렌저는 다시 안 살 거예요!

title: A solid OK
body: I’ve received this as a sample a few times now and it’s a solid ok. I don’t want to leave a poor review because it didn’t cause any breakouts but I don’t really feel like it did anything positive for my skin either. It cleaned my skin adequately but I wasn’t wow’d by it and I don’t think it’ll ever be a full size purchase for me. I didn’t like the smell as well, I can’t place what the scent is that I’m smelling but it’s not pleasant to me.
bodyKo: 샘플로 몇 번 받아 써봤는데 그냥 무난한 정도예요. 트러블이 나지 않아서 나쁜 평가는 안 남기고 싶지만, 피부에 특별히 좋은 효과가 있다고 느끼지도 못했어요. 세정은 적당히 되는데 감탄할 만한 점은 없고, 정품 구매할 생각은 없어요. 향도 별로였어요, 어떤 향인지 딱 집어 말할 수는 없는데 제게는 불쾌했어요.

body: Thanks to this brand, and tatcha, my face has cleared up immensely! One of the BEST out there.
bodyKo: 이 브랜드 덕분에, 그리고 Tatcha 덕분에 제 얼굴이 정말 많이 깨끗해졌어요! 정말 최고 중 하나예요.

body: I’ve been using this cleanser for several years, and it’s great. I wouldn’t say that it’s good for removing makeup, but it’s perfect as the 2nd step in a double cleanse.
bodyKo: 몇 년째 이 클렌저를 사용 중인데 정말 좋아요. 메이크업 제거용으로는 딱 좋다고는 못 하겠지만, 이중 세안 두 번째 단계로는 완벽해요.

title: Flawless!
body: Amazing!!!! I love this as a primer before putting on the flawless foundation, they go together so wel!
bodyKo: 대박!!!! 완벽한 파운데이션 바르기 전에 프라이머로 쓰는데, 둘이 정말 잘 어울려요!

title: Great cream
body: I received this mini size sample from Influenster. First it looked thick cream, but it melts on my skin and very easy to spread. Doesn’t leave my face greasy but very hydrating! I wish this cream contained some benefits such as Ceramide, Hyaluronic Acid or Collagen.
bodyKo: 인플루엔스터에서 미니 샘플로 받았어요. 처음에는 진한 크림 같았는데 피부에 닿으면 녹으면서 펴 바르기 정말 쉬워요. 얼굴이 번들거리지 않고 촉촉해요! 세라마이드, 히알루론산, 콜라겐 같은 성분이 들어있었으면 좋겠어요.

title: Started great, but ended poorly
body: I got this as a sample and fell in love. The consistency is so with and creamy, you don’t need to use much. And it makes your face glow. It really seemed like magic cream. I liked it so much I bought some. I used it for 2 weeks and noticed my dry patch on my forehead (that I previously struggled to get rid of) was starting to come back. I used my exfoliKate and doubled down on my serums but it persisted. Then I started to get dry around my mouth. I upped my water intake but it persisted. I finally decided that it may be the moisturizer. I stopped using it and within a week the dry patches were gone.
bodyKo: 샘플로 받아서 써봤는데 너무 좋아서 반했어요. 제형이 부드럽고 크리미해서 적은 양으로도 충분하고, 얼굴에 광이 나더라고요. 정말 마법 같은 크림 같았어요. 너무 좋아서 정품도 샀죠. 2주 정도 썼는데, 전에 없애기 힘들었던 이마의 건조한 부분이 다시 생기기 시작했어요. 각질 제거제랑 세럼도 더 열심히 썼는데도 계속됐어요. 입 주변도 건조해지기 시작해서 물도 더 많이 마셨는데도 나아지지 않았어요. 결국 이 크림 때문인 것 같아 사용을 중단했더니 일주일 만에 건조한 부분이 사라졌어요.

title: Happy
body: Makes my skin feel soft and moisturized doesnt feel heavy use a small amount a little bit goes a long way. Do like this product
bodyKo: 피부가 부드럽고 촉촉해져서 좋아요. 무겁지 않고 소량만 발라도 오래가요. 이 제품 정말 마음에 들어요.

title: Light moisture and skin-tone-evening Magic!
body: I’m really enjoying this cream so far. I’ve been using it for about a week and I already notice a more even skin tone and consistent hydration. It makes me feel young and fancy. It’s light and goes on smooth. I only need a little bit to cover my face. It might be my new favorite all-purpose moisturizer (in conjunction with a serum and eye cream).
titleKo: 가벼운 보습과 피부 톤 정돈의 마법!
bodyKo: 이 크림 정말 잘 쓰고 있어요. 한 주 정도 써봤는데 피부 톤이 더 고르고 수분도 꾸준히 유지되는 게 느껴져요. 젊고 고급스러운 느낌이에요. 가볍고 부드럽게 발려서 얼굴 전체에 조금만 발라도 충분해요. 세럼과 아이크림과 함께 쓰면 다용도 보습제로 최고일 것 같아요.

title: Love it !
body: Absolutely LOVING this product. It is truly a cream, thick and rich but skin absorbs it wonderfully. My skin is glowing. Have not had and sensitivity issues or breakouts, unlike so many other “cream” formulas I have tried. A bit on the pricier side , but so worth it. If you want to invest in a good cream look no further.
bodyKo: 이 제품 완전 사랑해요. 진짜 크림 같고, 진하고 풍부한데 피부에 잘 흡수돼요. 피부가 빛나 보여요. 다른 ‘크림’ 제형들처럼 민감하거나 트러블도 없었어요. 가격대는 좀 있지만 그만큼 가치 있어요. 좋은 크림에 투자하고 싶다면 이거 추천해요.

title: I recommend
body: I have been using this product for over a month.  I am glad I have been able to try it.  This skin care not only moisturizes my skin well it makes it not feel greasy at all.  A little bit goes a long way as well.    Lots of amazing ingredients in this cream as well that is great for my aging skin.
bodyKo: 한 달 넘게 사용 중인데 써보길 잘했어요. 이 스킨케어는 촉촉하게 해줄 뿐 아니라 전혀 번들거리지 않아요. 소량으로도 오래가고요. 노화 피부에 좋은 성분들도 많이 들어 있어 만족해요.

body: I like the texture of this moisturizer. It is thick but not greasy! The scent smells like a spa. I would recommend this product to someone with dry skin. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.
bodyKo: 이 보습제 제형이 마음에 들어요. 진하지만 끈적이지 않아요! 향은 스파 같은 느낌이에요. 건성 피부인 분께 추천하고 싶어요. 샘플로 받은 제품이지만 솔직하게 느낀 점이에요.

title: Good transition to fall
body: this product was a great transition moisturizer into fall! Not too heavy, and perfect for daily wear. Not sure I would wear it in the summer as it’s a bit too heavy for that. I received the magic cream as a free gift in exchange for my honest review.
bodyKo: 이 제품은 가을철로 넘어갈 때 쓰기 좋은 보습제였어요! 너무 무겁지 않고 데일리로 딱이에요. 여름에는 좀 무거워서 잘 안 쓸 것 같아요. 솔직한 리뷰를 위해 매직 크림을 무료 선물로 받았어요.

body: This moisturizer felt v soft and smooth on my skin and it didn’t make me break out or itchy at all. I got this as a sample and I definitely plan on buying a bigger container of it
bodyKo: 이 보습제는 피부에 아주 부드럽고 매끈하게 느껴졌고, 트러블이나 가려움도 전혀 없었어요. 샘플로 받아서 써봤는데, 꼭 큰 용량으로 구매할 계획이에요.

title: Great for Dry Skin, Not my Favorite Scent
body: I have extremely dry skin so I am always looking for a toner that will help hydrate my skin after cleansing instead of continuing to strip the oils from my face. I love the texture of this toner. It is thicker and more of a gel consistency than a super watery toner. I love the way it feels on my skin, it goes on even and does not leave me feeling sticky. My only complaint is that the watermelon scent smells more like cactus water and a fake watermelon flavor. I also have the Watermelon Sleeping Mask and I like that watermelon scent better. Full disclosure, I was sent this product for free to review. I am a fan of all glow recipe products and buy their other products on my own dime frequently.
titleKo: 건성 피부에 좋아요, 향은 제 취향은 아니에요
bodyKo: 저는 극건성 피부라 세안 후 피부를 촉촉하게 해줄 토너를 항상 찾고 있어요. 이 토너 제형이 정말 좋아요. 너무 묽은 토너보다는 좀 더 걸쭉한 젤 타입이에요. 피부에 발랐을 때 고르게 발리고 끈적임도 없어서 좋아요. 다만 수박 향이 선인장 물 같고 인공적인 수박 맛 같은 느낌이라 아쉬워요. 워터멜론 슬리핑 마스크도 있는데 그 향이 더 마음에 들어요. 참고로 이 제품은 리뷰용으로 무료 제공받았고, 저는 글로우 레시피 제품을 좋아해서 다른 제품도 자주 제 돈 주고 구매해요.

title: a definite MUST with a particularly good smell!!!
body: i wanted to give this product a try, partly because of my uneven texture issues, I have combination skin so sometimes it’s dry, oily then normal on it’s best days. I really really love it, it smells super sweet and it has a great feel on my skin. I mostly use this by poring it on my hands and gently padding it to my face and neck as opposed to applying it with a cotton pad cause the product is very syrupy and sticky which causes it to slide off any surface object that I put it on.

title: absolutely insane
body: my forehead was breaking out the worst it’s ever been. all i’d been using was a face wash, and moisturizer. i decided to go back to using this toner after trying it out for a couple weeks a long time ago, and put just a little bit in my hands and patted it into my face in the morning right after washing my face, and right after night showers. i didn’t put a lot just to be careful. the pictures are 3 days apart, jan 1, and jan 4. the results were crazy. not sure if it was just because of this product, but either way, i’m happy how it turned out.
bodyKo: 제 이마가 지금까지 중에 가장 심하게 트러블이 났었어요. 그동안은 세안제랑 보습제만 사용했었는데, 예전에 잠깐 써보고 다시 이 토너를 쓰기로 했어요. 손에 조금 덜어서 아침 세안 직후랑 밤 샤워 후에 얼굴에 톡톡 두드려 발랐어요. 많이 바르진 않고 조심했어요. 사진은 1월 1일과 1월 4일, 3일 차이인데 결과가 정말 놀라웠어요. 이 제품 때문인지는 확실치 않지만, 어쨌든 결과에 만족해요.

body: This product is ok.  I use the Alpha H gold, and prefer it to this product.  I purchased this hoping to save money.  I gave it three stars, as for the price, it isn’t horrible.  BUT - I do feel it can make my skin dry for a couple of days.  So I will use it, but not sure I’d ever repurchase.  One bottle will last me at least a year, so that also deserves three stars, as that is more than fair for the price.  But I prefer my other mentioned acid.  This I may reach for once every couple of months.

body: tingles a little- takes a while to get used and has a strong smell but it works really well for acne and scars. baby soft skin.

title: A Glam-pire facial that won’t break the bank!
body: This is the poster child for “more bang for your buck”—using this just once a month makes my face clearer and more even on average than it was before. It tingles a little both when I first apply it and while I’m wearing it, but as long as I don’t have any open wounds/zits on my face, I’m fine (like, 2 out of 10 on the pain scale at worse). I recommend working your way up to using this—try something like a 10% AHA/BHA/PHA weekly before committing to something this strong.
bodyKo: 이 제품은 '가성비 최고'의 대표 주자예요—한 달에 한 번만 사용해도 제 얼굴이 전보다 훨씬 맑고 고르게 변했어요. 처음 바를 때랑 바르고 있을 때 약간 따끔거림이 있는데, 얼굴에 상처나 뾰루지가 없으면 괜찮아요(통증 정도는 10점 만점에 2점 정도). 처음부터 강한 제품을 쓰기보다는 10% AHA/BHA/PHA 같은 걸 주 1회 정도 쓰면서 점차 적응하는 걸 추천해요.

title: wow
body: OMG as good as my dermatologist in-office peels and at the cost of an ice-cream come in manhattan for about 20 uses
bodyKo: 와, 제 피부과 전문의가 시술해주는 필링만큼 좋고, 맨해튼 아이스크림 한 개 값으로 약 20번 쓸 수 있다니 대박이에요.

title: NOT FOR SENSITIVE SKIN
body: This is not a beginner’s product for chemical exfoliants. If you consider your skin sensitive in any way I do not recommend this product. If you experience redness or irritation with harsh products, do not use this product. I tried it for almost a full month with three or four uses total and each time my cheeks became extremely irritated and red with red splotches showing up the following days. I wanted to see if that was my skin adjusting to the product but it’s happened each time and I’m going to listen to my skin and stop using this product. By the way, I am not prone to red spots or breakouts ESPECIALLY in this area.
bodyKo: 이 제품은 화학적 각질 제거 초보자용이 아니에요. 피부가 조금이라도 민감하다면 추천하지 않아요. 자극적인 제품에 붉어지거나 따가움이 느껴진다면 사용하지 마세요. 거의 한 달 동안 3~4회 써봤는데 매번 볼이 심하게 붉어지고 붉은 반점이 며칠간 나타났어요. 피부가 적응하는 건지 확인해보려 했지만 매번 반복돼서 피부 신호를 듣고 사용을 중단하려고요. 참고로 저는 특히 이 부위에 붉은 반점이나 트러블이 잘 생기지 않는 편이에요.

title: Big improvements with consistent use
body: I’ve definitely noticed big changes in my skin, especially when using consistently (2x per week). I have worry lines between my eyebrows and these pretty much disappear when using this. It also really helps with my forehead and smile lines. I’ve also noticed improvement in my skin texture.
bodyKo: 특히 주 2회 꾸준히 쓰면서 피부에 큰 변화를 확실히 느꼈어요. 미간 주름이 거의 사라졌고, 이마와 웃을 때 생기는 주름에도 정말 도움이 됐어요. 피부 결도 많이 좋아졌어요.

title: AWESOME
body: This stuff is AMAZING and CHEAP! if you have never used skin products with acid before I would leave this on for less than 10 minutes and then gradually increase to 10 minutes when your skin can handle it. I personally only noticed a bit of a tingly feeling by my nose and mouth the first time I used it, but it definitely wasn’t that bad and I kept it on for the full 10 minutes. Afterwards my skin was so smooth and so soft. I try and use this once a week if I remember and I will say my skin is a lot less flakey and I feel like some of my red acne scars have faded a bit. Hopefully with further use they’ll start to disappear more!
bodyKo: 이 제품 정말 대박이고 저렴해요! 산성 제품을 처음 쓰는 분이라면 10분 미만으로 바르고 점차 10분까지 늘리는 걸 추천해요. 저는 처음 쓸 때 코랑 입 주변이 약간 따끔거렸지만 크게 불편하지 않았고 10분 동안 그대로 뒀어요. 사용 후 피부가 정말 부드럽고 매끈해졌어요. 기억날 때마다 주 1회 사용하려고 하는데, 각질도 훨씬 덜하고 붉은 여드름 자국도 조금 옅어진 것 같아요. 계속 쓰면 더 좋아질 거라 기대해요!

title: HOLY GRAIL FOR ACNE/BUMPS/HYPERPIGMENTATION
body: This thing is literally MAGIC in a bottle. I’m a long time sufferer for acne for almost a year now and i’m also a very hardcore picker. I always over analyze my skin and I pick at pimples which unclean hands which leads to infection , inflammation then post hyperpigmentation. I just received this yesterday and let me tell you, my skin was INSTANTLY glowy! My hyperpigmentation isn’t completely gone, but it has noticeably faded after using this!I had these really bad bumps on my forehead that would just not go away and this thing took it away instantly! My skin has never been more smoother than a baby’s butt and I can see some scarring fading fast!! Love this product! Please also don’t forget to follow up with sunscreen in the morning otherwise it will actually darken your dark spots after exfoliating the protective layer on the top of your skin! Nothing has worked for me, but this, I don’t know what it is, but this is literally AMAZING and a must have!

title: This Moisturizer is a Must-Try!!
body: I’ve always heard such great things about Korres but never got around to trying any of their products. I was super excited when I received  their sample sized Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream because one of my goals for this year was to really focus on a good skincare routine. I had no idea what to expect from this moisturizer and after trying it out, it’s definitely a moisturizer I will be considering adding to my routine. For one, this moisturizer smells sooooo good! The fruity smell is subtle and  isn’t overpowering at all. I love that this moisturizer is lightweight but still gave my skin moisture. This gel moisturizer has a thicker texture than a water based cream so a little goes a long way. I also loved that despite it being tacky when first applied, it dried fast and I was able to move on with my routine.  Overall I really enjoyed using this moisturizer.The salicylic acid and hyaluronic acid is especially good if you have oily/acne prone skin like myself. I would definitely consider adding this moisturizer to your skincare routine this

title: Amazing hydration!
body: I received a sample of this cream as a complimentary gift for my honest review. This cream is wonderful. I love that it’s lightweight, clean and non-greasy. It absorbs quickly and feels soft on the skin. The glow it gives is divine.It has a subtle fragrance that I really like.  It also has great ingredients like salicylic acid, hyaluronic acid and willowherb extract, to name a few. The salicylic acid is helpful in treating breakouts , while still allowing me to wear moisturizer. I love that this cream doesn’t clog pores. It actually blurs them, which makes the application of primer and makeup much more smooth! It goes well under makeup, which is a major bonus. It smooths and preps my face nicely for primer, and layering makeup.I have sensitive, combination, acne-prone skin, and this cream didn’t break me out once.  A little bit goes a long way. I would definitely add it in my current skincare routine. It’s vegan and cruelty-free. I recommend it for any skin type.
